module: "Empty" checkpoint marker: it implements the common race marker interface (init, update, setToCheckpoint, setMode, setVisibility, hide, show, createMarkers, clearMarkers) without displaying anything. Used to disable visual markers. The module returns a constructor: require('scenario/raceMarkers/noneMarker')(id) gives an object of class C.
notes: C:init does not store the identifier: self.id stays nil. Used via scenario_race_marker.createRaceMarker (which stores the marker in idToMarker[marker.id]), this produces a nil key and a Lua error: probable bug.
All methods are empty, except hide and show which call setVisibility (empty).

C.desc: Marker with no visual effect, same interface as the other race markers.

init.desc: Constructor called by the module: does nothing (the id is not stored).
